claims.claim: Shoals Q2 2026 revenue rose 47.4% year over year to $163.4M and backlog plus awarded orders reached a record $801.4M, up 19.4% year over year.
Backlog growth includes emerging battery-energy-storage demand, while the company also describes data-center power systems as a target market.
The ITC affirmed a Section 337 violation by Voltage involving infringing LYNX trunk-bus products, strengthening evidence around Shoals' IP enforceability.

factors.name: demand visibility
factors.basis: Record backlog and awarded orders provide forward workload visibility.

factors.name: adjacent electrification markets
factors.basis: Storage and data-center power broaden the addressable infrastructure opportunity beyond utility solar.

factors.name: IP defensibility
factors.basis: ITC victory provides external legal validation of protected technology.

risks.risk: Backlog does not guarantee timing, margin or ultimate conversion to recognized revenue.

unknowns.unknown: Long-run contribution from storage and data-center markets is not yet separately quantified in the cited evidence.

claims.claim: Shoals reaffirmed FY2026 revenue guidance of $600M-$640M and adjusted EBITDA guidance of $118M-$132M after Q2.
Q2 gross margin fell to 30.3% from 37.2% because of new-facility ramp inefficiencies, product mix, quality rework/corrective actions, material inefficiencies and lease amortization.

factors.name: growth execution
factors.basis: Strong revenue growth and maintained full-year outlook support demand execution.

factors.name: manufacturing execution
factors.basis: Facility ramp and product-quality costs materially pressured gross margin and require proof of normalization.

risks.risk: Operational inefficiency and quality corrective actions could delay margin conversion despite strong demand.

contradictions.claim: Record backlog coexists with lower gross margin.
contradictions.resolution: Demand strength and manufacturing efficiency are separate dimensions; backlog supports demand while facility/quality costs weaken near-term conversion economics.

unknowns.unknown: Timing and magnitude of margin recovery after facility stabilization remain unknown.
